<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbons, I need the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample. This will show signals in the aromatic region (≈110‑160 ppm). By counting those signals, I can infer the number of distinct aromatic carbon environments, which corresponds to the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule (assuming each aromatic carbon gives a separate signal). I'll request the carbon NMR spectrum.</thought>
